troubleshooting: cite source or state source gap
implementation: provide PowerShell when Windows setup is involved

v1_7_source_hardening.purpose: Machine-readable answer gates created after Topics 20-25 source verification.
global_rules: Prefer canonical lane files over raw notes, but apply v1.7 claim status overrides before answering.
Do not present not_verified_as_hard_fact claims as hard facts.
For volatile model, hardware, benchmark, and percentage claims, either cite the verified source or qualify the statement.
Raw user-expanded notes remain provenance; corrected overlays govern current answer phrasing.
When a source date was corrected, preserve the source but use the corrected year/date label.

status_behaviors.verified_official: Safe to use with citation; prefer over secondary sources.
status_behaviors.verified_primary_with_date_correction: Use the claim but correct the date/version label.
status_behaviors.verified_primary_with_nuance: Use only scoped wording; avoid broad extrapolation.
status_behaviors.verified_secondary: Use as secondary support only; qualify if official source is absent.
status_behaviors.not_verified_as_hard_fact: Do not present as fact; mark as estimate, hypothesis, or unresolved.
status_behaviors.needs_correction: Replace older phrasing with corrected wording.
